title: Tunisian Chicken Tagine Stir Fry
description: A fusion of Chinese and Tunisian flavors, this dish brings the tender taste of old-style stir-fry with the bold spices of a traditional tagine.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of hazelnut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the chicken and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp of hazelnut oil, tunisian tagine spice mix, and sliced onions to the skillet.
Cook until the onions are translucent, about 3 minutes.
Add the sliced bell peppers and mushrooms to the skillet.
Cook until the vegetables are tender-crisp, about 4 minutes.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir in the old-style soy sauce.
Cook for an additional 1-2 minutes, until the chicken is coated in the sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro before serving.
